about: Words where two sources that state the same pair of texts disagree about one word, and this project read the translation to settle which of them is right. Each ruling names the verse canonically, the witness word by its letters (accents and case aside) and which occurrence of those letters in the verse it is, the source whose statement stands and the one whose statement about that word only is set aside, and the reason as read in the translation. The Berean and Clear Bible loaders read this file on every load and redraw: a Berean absence overruled is not written, and a Clear Bible record overruled loses that word, or is withheld where it is the record's only witness word. Nothing else in either source changes.
decidedBy: the Essenthos project's reading of the Berean Standard Bible's English, made by its lead; not the owner's decision
